question: Where was Mahatma Gandhi’s first major public appearance in India after his return from South Africa?

options.text: At the Indigo Satyagraha at Champaran, in 1917
At the opening ceremony of the Banaras Hindu University, Banaras, in 1916
At the mill workers’ protest at Kheda, in 1917
At the protest against the King’s visit at Bombay, in 1916

solution:
The correct answer is __**At the opening ceremony of the Banaras Hindu University, Banaras, in 1916**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mahatma Gandhi returned back to India in January 1915.
 
• He returned back from South Africa.
 
• In South Africa he led a racist regime with the method of mass agitation.
 
• He called this mass agitation as satyagraha.
 
• After arriving in India, he led various styagrahas in different parts of the country.

Thus, we can say that Mahatma Gandhi returned back to india in January 1915.
